3. Recommended checking for malware using Windows Defender or another antivirus program.
4. Instructed the user to free up disk space by deleting unused files and programs.
5. Advised disabling unnecessary startup programs.
6. Suggested updating the operating system and drivers.
7. Discussed the possibility of upgrading RAM or switching to an SSD.

**Outcome:** The user acknowledged the troubleshooting steps but did not confirm if any improvements were observed. Further follow-up may be required to assess the situation.
